edits.new:
# --- RELINK DIVISION (FACT-0090/0093) ---
        # A bijection cannot express out-degree 2, so this call collapsed 14 of the 24
        # divisions present pre-ILP. Duplicating each source row and PRICING the copy lets
        # linear_sum_assignment SELECT which sources earn a second child, jointly over
        # motion + raw distance + learned probability (the cost already carries all three).
        # That is a joint scorer, not another AND-gate; blanket relaxation scored -0.0081.
        # in-degree <= 1 is preserved (one row per column); out-degree <= 2 by construction.
        _n_src = len(source_ids)
        if RELINK_DIVISION_PENALTY >= 0.0:
            cost_aug = np.vstack([cost, cost + RELINK_DIVISION_PENALTY])
        else:
            cost_aug = cost
        row_ind, col_ind = linear_sum_assignment(cost_aug)
        matches: list[tuple[int, int, float, float, float]] = []
        _second = 0
        for r, c in zip(row_ind, col_ind):
            if cost_aug[r, c] >= big:
                continue
            _i = int(r) % _n_src
            if int(r) >= _n_src:
                _second += 1
            matches.append((
                source_ids[_i],
                target_ids[int(c)],
                float(raw_dist[_i, c]),
                float(motion_dist[_i, c]),
                float(prob_matrix[_i, c]),
            ))
        if _second:
            stats["relink_division_second_children"] = (
                stats.get("relink_division_second_children", 0) + _second
            )
        return matches
